EasonGuuu/Deskweek.body:
# DeskWeek · Weekly Calendar & Checklist

DeskWeek is a desktop weekly calendar and to-do tool designed for Windows. It sits directly on the desktop background without replacing or disrupting the system wallpaper. All to-do and calendar data is stored by default only on your local computer.

## Download and Use

You can download it from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/releases/latest):
- **Installer (Setup.exe)**: Suitable for most users. Supports an installation wizard, automatically creates desktop and Start menu shortcuts, supports launching at startup, and can be uninstalled with one click from Control Panel.
- **Portable version (Portable.zip)**: Suitable for users who prefer a green, install-free app. Extract to any folder and double-click `DeskWeek.exe` to use it.

> Tip: If you use the portable version, you only need to keep the `data/` folder when upgrading to fully migrate existing schedules and settings. The installed version automatically preserves user data when overwriting an existing installation.

## Related Documents

- [Multi-monitor fullscreen independent detection notes](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/blob/HEAD/docs/multimonitor-fullscreen-fix.md): Explains how fullscreen is determined independently for primary and secondary displays in a multi-monitor environment.
- [Multi-device collaboration and sync guide](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/blob/HEAD/docs/android-lan-integration.md): Guide for interoperating between Windows and Android phones/tablets.
- [Offline QR code transfer guide](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/blob/HEAD/docs/offline-json-qr.md): How to transfer data by scanning QR codes face to face without a network.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/blob/HEAD/docs/故障排查.md): Solutions for when the floating window does not appear, briefly crashes, shows error messages, or fails to save.
- [Desktop layer and live wallpaper compatibility](https://github.com/EasonGuuu/Deskweek/blob/HEAD/docs/桌面层与动态壁纸兼容性.md): Notes on multi-monitor use, Wallpaper Engine live wallpaper compatibility, and display behavior.

## Main Features

- **Desktop widget and standalone management center**: Browse your schedule on the desktop at any time, or open the management center to efficiently enter and organize tasks.
- **Multiple calendar views**: Switch freely between year, month, week, and day views.
- **Flexible to-do sorting**: Sort by due date, creation order, date, and specific time, among other rules.
- **Full task management**: Supports titles, detailed notes, checking off completed items, a recycle bin, and one-click restore.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
```

SuperWheel/dsh-cliworker-now.description: DeepSeek Harness multi-CLI agent sidebar plugin: independent conversations, account management, role presets, and task follow-up chats
SuperWheel/dsh-cliworker-now.body:
# dsh-cliworker-now

**Simplified Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/SuperWheel/dsh-cliworker-now/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

**In DeepSeek Harness, give different CLIs a shared collaboration space.**

Choose a CLI, model, and role, then dispatch named agents. View their progress in the sidebar, receive results, and continue the same task.

[Installation](#安装与更新) · [Getting Started](#使用方法) · [FAQ](#常见问题) · [Report an Issue](https://github.com/SuperWheel/dsh-cliworker-now/issues)

## What is this

dsh-cliworker-now is a **multi-CLI agent plugin** for DeepSeek Harness. It connects AI CLIs running in the terminal to Harness. The main conversation handles dispatching and receiving results, and the right sidebar uses Harness's native full conversation view to show each agent's progress, usage, and status.

You still use each CLI's own accounts, models, and native sessions. The plugin organizes them. The plugin does not include model services, subscriptions, or API quota.

- **Development collaboration**: Have Codex review code, then follow up under the same name.
- **Writing and editing**: Configure different roles for logic, style, business review, and body revision.
- **Long-task follow-up**: Independent conversations and execution records are both kept, so work can continue after a task ends.

After installation, it appears in Harness as **CLI Worker / CLI Worker Now**.

## Features

- **One entry point, many CLIs**: Name a CLI in the main conversation. The sidebar groups all tasks by CLI.
- **Native conversation experience**: Sub-sessions directly use Harness's conversation view, input box, model and permission controls, "+" menu, and usage statistics. They support queuing, stopping, and ending follow-up chats. After you switch CLI accounts, old tasks automatically resume under the current account. If the original session cannot be restored, the prior record is attached in a new session to continue (prior conversation will be sent to the current account's provider).
- **Preserves native capabilities**: Each CLI uses its own protocol, login, and sessions. Model and reasoning-effort settings are read from each CLI's actual catalog and the current account, rather than copying rules from other CLIs.
- **Native tools first, DSH tools as fallback**: CLIs use their own read/write, search, command, web, and skill tools first. DSH tools that overlap with these are no longer passed to the CLI. For same-named MCP servers, only the one the CLI configures itself is kept. Capabilities the CLI lacks (such as command execution in Pi), as well as MCP servers and skills unique to DSH, are provided as fallbacks via `dsh_worker_tools`. Their descriptions are marked "fallback". Each execution still goes through Harness permissions and approval. Codex, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, MiMo, and Grok…

All platforms share the same underlying Python CLI tools and SKILL.md workflows. The upper layer adapts the registration mechanism of each of the four platforms separately.

## Feature Overview

- **71 tools** — market data, technical analysis, candlestick patterns, capital flows, valuation history, earnings calendar, shareholders/ETFs/dividends, news and sentiment, risk screening, market regime, and more

## ⚠️ Notes

**Please read the following before using this API.**

- **This is unofficial.** It has no affiliation whatsoever with the BOATRACE official website or related organizations.
- **Not real-time.** Because data is updated periodically at about 10-minute intervals via GitHub Actions, there may be a delay of roughly 10–20 minutes before the latest information is reflected.
- **Accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed.** Due to collection and conversion processes, missing or incorrect data may be included.
- **If you need official information, always check the BOATRACE official website.**
- **Use at your own risk.**

---

## 📝 Overview

This API provides access to boatrace (motorboat racing) data. The data is published on GitHub Pages and provided in JSON format.

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Supported venues | All 24 venues nationwide (one day's data includes information for all venues) |
| Available data | Race cards, pre-race information, results |

---

## 🌐 Endpoint

Supported period: **From January 1, 2026 onward**

```bash
https://boatraceopenapi.github.io/api/v1/YYYY/YYYYMMDD.json
```

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year, month, and day
- Dates are based on Japan Standard Time (JST / UTC+9)

> If you specify a date with no data (outside the supported period, future dates, etc.), GitHub Pages returns HTTP 404.

For details on the JSON structure and each field, see the schema documentation.

→ [docs/v1/schema.md](https://github.com/boatraceopenapi/api/blob/HEAD/docs/v1/schema.md)

# Genshin University Alliance

Welcome to the Genshin University Alliance project! This project aims to collect and organize lists of Genshin-related universities across the country (currently 314 universities, of which 81 are valid), providing a campus hub.

Non-university institutions may also be added~

If you like this project, feel free to give it a star on [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University).
**The list prioritizes valid domains. Within each validity group, schools are sorted alphabetically by school name.**

## How to Submit
:::caution
**You must purchase a domain from a cloud provider and configure the corresponding DNS resolution and redirects before it can be listed on this site. You must also test that the domain loads normally in a browser. Otherwise, it cannot be listed on this site.**
:::
1. **Go to the project**: Click [GitHub](https://github.com/cokice/List-of-genshin-University) at the top right.
2. **Fork this repository**: Find and click the "Fork" button at the top right of the page to copy this project to your GitHub account.
3. **Clone the repository**: Clone the repository you just forked to your local computer.
4. **Create a new branch**: Create a new branch for the changes you plan to make.
5. **Add a domain**: In the new folder on your branch, add your domain following the instructions in the README there.
6. **Open a Pull Request**: Open a Pull Request on GitHub to merge your changes into the original repository. Before opening it, make sure your changes are accurate and have been tested.
7. **If you are not familiar with GitHub, fill out the survey directly: [Genshin University Information Collection](https://wj.qq.com/s2/14161038/95a1/). Make sure you have registered the domain and set up the redirect.**
8. **Other questions: email howen.huang@qq.com**

   **Format requirement: your school name + your configured domain. Also make sure your link has been tested by others and can be accessed.**

   **Example: Harvard University www.原神大学.com**

## University List (2026-11-11 19:18 UTC+8)

Status legend:
- :white_check_mark: Verified by the server to be accessible and redirecting successfully. Also shows the redirect method.
- :question: Verified by the server that the domain is accessible, but the redirect failed. Shows the error reason. This status is considered a valid domain.
- :warning: Links in the table point directly to the corresponding university rather than going through the domain redirect. This status is considered an invalid domain.
- :x: The server cannot access the corresponding address. Shows the error reason. Common causes and solutions for the site administrator:
  - `NXDOMAIN` the domain cannot be resolved (register a domain and set up DNS resolution first!)
  - `Connection error`…

dujeongil-galaxy/shuangxiugou.body:
# ShuangxiuGo · 双休购 (Two-Day Weekend Shopping)

Turn the KPIs your boss uses to evaluate you into voting currency that workers use to evaluate the boss.

> **Project scope**: This repository is the main site of ShuangxiuGo (双休购), deployed as a static GitHub Pages site. The account also hosts two other repositories: `shuangxiugou-guide` (a static backup of the info site) and `shuangxiu-go-archive` (an archive of a third-party site). Their data is not mixed with this main site.
>
> **Inclusion principles**: Objective and neutral, with no emotional wording. Cases with incomplete evidence chains are still rated, not avoided. Ratings are based only on monthly rest days, and U-level ratings must include an 'evidence-missing note'. The relationship between the two sites' data, the full rating criteria, and past corrections are documented in **[README-详情.md](https://github.com/dujeongil-galaxy/shuangxiugou/blob/HEAD/README-详情.md#scope)**. This page keeps only a summary to avoid making the homepage too long.

> Based on [ZhiqingHeyi/shuangxiugou](https://github.com/ZhiqingHeyi/shuangxiugou), modified, MIT License

## Online use

Open **https://dujeongil-galaxy.github.io/shuangxiugou/**

> **No installation, no configuration, and no coding knowledge needed.** Open the URL above in any browser, including mobile browsers, to start checking.
> If the page won't open, try [this one-page directory of all ShuangxiuGo-related projects on GitHub](https://dujeongil-galaxy.github.io/shuangxiugou/projects.html). It marks which repositories have a directly accessible online site and which only have code, so you don't click into search results only to find they don't work.

---

## 🧭 Related Project Navigation

**[Open the related projects navigation page →](https://dujeongil-galaxy.github.io/shuangxiugou/projects.html)**

Searching 'ShuangxiuGo' (双休购) on GitHub returns more than a dozen repositories, but **only about half of them actually have a working website**. The navigation page groups open-source projects related to '双休购 / shuangxiugou / two-day-weekend' and sorts them into three groups by online site availability:

- **Directly accessible online** (5): open and use, no local deployment needed

mtdhllf/Tug-Android.body:
Tug-Android is the Android version of [Tug](https://github.com/mtdhllf/Tug-Desktop). The desktop version (Rust) focuses on BitTorrent and Windows integration. The Android version centers on **HTTP/HTTPS multi-connection downloads, resumable downloads, and background downloads**, and also splits the download core into lightweight Kotlin libraries that can be reused externally.

### Project Results

- Completed HTTP/HTTPS multi-connection downloads, resumable downloads, background downloads, and publishing to the public directory.
- Completed BitTorrent/magnet downloads (libtorrent4j), with Files/Peers/Trackers detail views.
- Split the download core into 5 reusable libraries (`tug-engine-core`, `tug-http`, `tug-http-okhttp`, `tug-store-sqlite`, `tug-engine-torrent`), including two HTTP implementations: JDK and OkHttp.
- Provides two minimal integration demos, `sample-http` and `sample-torrent`, covering initialization, settings, list status, and pause/resume/delete. The HTTP demo integrates both the JDK and OkHttp implementations.

---

## Screenshots

| Home | Task List | Settings | New Download |
|---|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |  |

---

## Features

### Downloads
- HTTP/HTTPS multi-connection segmented downloads, 1–32 connections
- Resumable downloads: `.part` + metadata (completed segments + intra-segment offset checkpoints, 1-second granularity)
- Pause/resume, retry on failure, automatic redirects (≤10 times)
- ETag / Last-Modified / file size consistency checks
- SHA-256 verification (supported by the engine, UI integration pending)
- Global download speed limit, Wi-Fi only, automatic pause/resume on network loss
- After completion, files are published to the public download directory **`Download/Tug`** (Android 10+ uses MediaStore; Android 9 and below write directly)
- Never overwrites existing files (duplicate names automatically become `name (1).ext`)

### Tasks & UI
- Home (statistics / quick add / in progress / recently completed)
- Task list: search, filters (all/downloading/completed/failed), sorting (recent/speed/name), long-press multi-select for batch operations
- Task details: full progress, speed, ETA, save location, copy link, open/share file, delete confirmation
- Settings with six subpages: Download, Network, Notifications, Appearance (light/dark/follow system/dynamic color), Background & Battery, About
- Foreground service + notifications: progress, completion/failure, pause all; tapping a notification goes directly to task details
- Share receiving (links/torrents) and `tug://task/{id}` deep links

storytellerF/Feiya.body:
# Feiya

Feiya can share files and messages over the local network, and can also use an Android device as a Bluetooth keyboard for a computer, providing text sending and the physical key controls needed for keyboard settings.

## Requirements

- An Android 13 (API 33) or newer device with Bluetooth HID support.
- A computer that can pair with a Bluetooth keyboard.
- Bluetooth turned on, and the Bluetooth permissions Feiya requests granted.

## App Navigation and File Sharing

On phones, the bottom navigation switches between the Files, Messages, Keyboard, Security, and Settings pages; wider windows use a persistent side navigation. On large screens, selecting a shared file shows its details beside the list; on phones, use **Back to files** or the system back gesture to return to the list.

Use **Add files** to share documents. The file details provide a QR code for that file, local saving where supported, and **Remove from sharing**; removing a file from sharing does not delete the original. The top bar shows the server port, and while the server is running, tapping it opens the main QR code. Restart, stop, and clear sharing are in the more menu; clearing the list requires confirmation.

## Sending Text

1. Open the HID page. If your computer is not listed, first pair it through the Bluetooth settings, then select the computer in Feiya to connect.
2. Match **Target computer keyboard layout** to the input source enabled on your computer: US QWERTY (default), Dvorak, or Colemak. Turn off Caps Lock.
3. On the computer, focus the target text field.
4. Enter text in **Text to send**, tap **Send**, then check the result on the computer.

The layout selection applies to all text sent by Feiya in the current app Activity. You can keep editing the draft while a task is running; queued text is not affected.

### Supported Input

Text sending supports printable ASCII, including spaces, digits, and punctuation, as well as Tab, Enter, Backspace, Escape, and Delete. A Windows CRLF line break sends Enter only once. If a message contains unsupported characters such as Chinese characters or emoji, the entire message is rejected before any keystrokes are sent.

The layout selection tells Feiya how to produce characters on the computer. It does not change the computer's input source, and it does not expand the supported character set.

## Tracking and Cancelling Sends

The HID page lists each task's target computer, status, and number of completed keystrokes. Tasks run in order.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Queued | Waiting for the previous task to finish. |
| Sending | Sending keystrokes to the selected computer. |
| Cancelling | Stopping the task and attempting to release the current key. |
| Sent | Bluetooth accepted the keyboard report; confirm the input on the computer. |
| Failed | Sending stopped; the task shows the reason. |
| Cancelled | The task was stopped before completion. |

Use **Cancel** to stop a single task, or **Cancel all**…

vivibibi30/hyperpguard.body:
# HyperPGuard

Intercepts privacy reporting from HyperOS preinstalled components at four layers: collection entry points, local storage, external interfaces, and network egress.

[Simplified Chinese](https://github.com/vivibibi30/hyperpguard/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [English](https://github.com/vivibibi30/hyperpguard/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

The following is based on static analysis and runtime observation of preinstalled components on this device. These components collect device identifiers, app usage records, location, call behavior, and other information, and send it out over the network or through cross-process interfaces. This module intercepts these channels on a per-app basis, and its switches are linked to the LSPosed scope. Specific behavior is subject to observations on each device model and system version.

> **Maintenance pace**: This project is maintained by an individual. Development and verification rely mainly on AI assistance and self-funded real-device testing, and the long-term cost is borne personally by the author. The update frequency has been deliberately reduced: releases are published only for defects that affect usage, discovery of new reporting channels, or major system version adaptation. UI, copy, and minor feature changes will be merged into the next substantial update and will not be released separately. Issues are read, but no response time or implementation schedule is promised. Unconfirmed feature requests may remain unaddressed for a long time, or be handled together with similar changes.

Before modifying code, it is recommended to read [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vivibibi30/hyperpguard/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md) (collaboration conventions) and [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/vivibibi30/hyperpguard/blob/HEAD/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) (structure and extension steps).

This repository is the source repository itself: `src/` contains all of the Java implementation, and `build.sh` is the complete build script. It packages with `javac` + `d8` + `aapt2` + `zipalign` + `apksigner` and does not depend on Gradle. The APKs in Releases are built by it. `Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.vivibibi30.hyperpguard` is only the LSPosed index repository, and contains only APKs and the description.

> For personal study and research use only, on your own devices. Before use, please read [DISCLAIMER.txt](https://github.com/vivibibi30/hyperpguard/blob/HEAD/DISCLAIMER.txt). The "Hyper" in the name refers to the HyperOS platform. This project has no affiliation or partnership with Xiaomi, China Unicom, or other vendors.

# operator

## CLI 1.3: desktop capabilities in the terminal

In 1.3.1 the role and character of Operator were clarified, and real information about the OS, CPU and RAM was added. `system_info` checks current resources and, on request, NVIDIA GPU. CLI startup is clean by default; details are available with `--verbose`. The skills catalog in the system prompt has been shortened, but the full skill files are preserved. Repeated identical errors are now recognized earlier; useful long-running work is not limited by the number of steps.

CLI history, settings, and memory are stored on the device. When a cloud model is used, the request and the transmitted context are sent to its provider. Local storage does not mean that the network request is visible only to the owner.

The built-in tools `subagent`, `background_run`, `background_check`, `background_stop`, `github`, `browser`, `computer`, and `system_info` are loaded automatically. Plugins and MCP are not carried over from the desktop. Qwen works with reasoning enabled; there is no thinking/no-thinking switch. Models without reasoning support continue to work in their usual mode.

```bash
operator --doctor                  # environment check without contacting the model
operator                           # interactive terminal…
```
